elements_selected.content: Add tantivy crate to Cargo.toml. Use the latest stable version (0.22+). No feature flags needed beyond defaults. Run cargo check to verify the dependency resolves and compiles cleanly. Tantivy pulls in ~50 transitive dependencies and adds ~5-8 MB to binary size (acceptable per ADR-013-001, SPEC-013 §9.4). Do NOT add any other new dependencies in this task.
